technical.summary: Strong structural bullish setup with price above all key MAs and positive flow, but multiple overbought oscillators and fading momentum crossovers suggest caution on new entries; better suited for existing longs or pullback entries.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 72 days present elevated risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: modest congressional buying (small amounts, junior members) offset by greed-zone market conditions and absent news confirmation; neutral overall sentiment with mild caution warranted.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (93.9) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 72 days adds event risk; falling DXY provides modest relief for multinational ACN but insufficient to offset systemic risks.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with TEMA cross-up and Donchian breakout to new highs signals structural bullish setup with positive capital flow confirmation.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 75, Stoch K 95), fading momentum crossovers, weak volume conviction (0.69 ratio), combined with macro crisis (VIX 93.9, inverted yield curve, earnings risk in 72 days) and zero fundamental support create asymmetric downside risk.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows structural bullish alignment with price above all major MAs and positive flow confirmation, but entry quality is compromised by extreme overbought oscillators and fading momentum at resistance.
decision.primary_risk: Macro crisis conditions (VIX 93.9, inverted yield curve) combined with earnings event risk in 72 days and zero fundamental support create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs technical strength.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding ACN with 15 existing IT positions (20% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing position reduce conviction further; skip new entry and monitor for pullback setup.
